g.text: What has changed in the rules?
Sources checked on 3 October 2026 · Passage is distinct from implementation.
2026: 12 months each for the first two children; 18 for each additional child.
Transition rules apply. Passed on 1 Oct: 15 months for a second child from 2027.
Foreign members: back payments and family supplements
Passed on 1 Oct: expanded reciprocity, effective upon promulgation.
Check promulgation, implementation and decree-based exceptions.
Current: age 18+, permanent status for 3 years, local foreign-resident register.
No reciprocity condition. SEED proposes reciprocity and substantive residence.
Sources: legal guidance and welfare ministry · Reform proposals reflect SEED’s view
